topic: The D-0008 proof needs a dedicated flag-SETTING script (test:warehouse-proof), not just membership in a suite that leaves WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST unset
lesson: Registering the gated reconciliation test in test:db is NOT enough: test:db does not set WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1, so the leaf still self-skips there and autoreview reads it as an unrunnable proof. FIX: add a dedicated backend package.json script 'test:warehouse-proof' that itself sets WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 and runs backend/src/warehouse/reconciliation.repository.test.ts (the WAREHOUSE_PG_*/PGHOST/PGPORT connection env is still supplied by the host/operator, NOT hardcoded), and REMOVE the file from test:db (it is a warehouse-DB test, not an app-DB test). Then the registered command actually EXECUTES the proof when run against a warehouse; the pinned host command in tests.json becomes 'WAREHOUSE_PG_*... npm --prefix backend run test:warehouse-proof'. Keep it in test:hermetic too (self-skips there). Still demonstrated-host-evidence (decision 0009/D-0008), NOT CI-enforced.
